subtitle: Three crossings. Three homes to reclaim.
briefing: Beyond the crossing, three roadside settlements are held by the dead. Nera’s patrol joins Warden Sella’s relief party to reopen the route. The Tollkeeper commands this stretch of road; the company needs the villages and their shelter, not just his head.
hints: One bridge need not carry the whole army.
A welcoming village can keep a march alive. Stone sparks punish bones; shield their fragile adepts with infantry.
The southern bone bow arrives on turn 7. Capture and defend all three villages together, rotating wounded troops into friendly shelter.

intro.speaker: Warden Sella
intro.text: Their bowmen are watching the bridge. My spears can hold the banks, but the skeletons will barely feel their points.

intro.speaker: Nera
intro.text: Hold the approaches. Scouts, find another crossing. We need those villages open to the living.

victory.speaker: Warden Sella
victory.text: All three windows are lit. One family even lent us their kettle.

victory.speaker: Ivo
victory.text: There is still a bell sounding in the marsh. Every time it rings, another grave opens.

victory.speaker: Nera
victory.text: Then we go to the bell.
